newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan gets three bids for 5,000 T rice export.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan gets three bids for 5,000 T rice export.

text.p: The Rice Export Corporation of Pakistan (RECP) said on Monday it had received three bids for the sale and export of 5,000 tonnes of basmati variety Pak-7 1996/97 (July-June) rice containing seven percent broken rice.
The highest bid was $436 per tonne FOB, an official of the state-run corporation said, adding a decision on the bids was likely by Tuesday. The other two bids are at $435.10 and $425 per tonne.

Pakistan exported 1.571 million tonnes of rice worth $393 million in the first 10 months of fiscal 1996/97 (July-June) compared to 1.133 million worth $372 million in the same period a year ago. In April, rice exports fell to 180,094 tonnes worth $48 million compared to 372,828 worth $62 million in March and 118,141 worth $38 million in April 1996. -- Karachi newsroom 9221-5685192
